summary: The filing is a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered follow-on offering of 10,000,000 shares by Jade Biosciences, Inc. at $15.00 per share, raising $150M gross ($141M net). The offering is an underwritten shelf takedown under an existing S-3, not a special situation. There are no terms indicating acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation category. Joint book-runners are Jefferies, TD Cowen, UBS, and LifeSci Capital. Delivery is expected June 5, 2026. The filing is a routine capital raise with no extraordinary structural or strategic elements.
